The human ear hears sound frequencies from about 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz (20 kHz). Below that is infrasound and above it is ultrasound.
Excess glucose is polymerised and stored as glycogen, mainly in the liver and muscles. Starch is the storage form in plants.

value: Regions in high middle latitudes (cool, humid, coniferous belts)

value: Material in the rings condensed to form the planets revolving around the Sun
reasoning: In the nebular hypothesis a slowly rotating nebula CONTRACTS (it does not expand), spinning faster and flattening, leaving rings of material behind as the proto-Sun forms. Those rings condensed into the planets. Options A, B and C each describe expansion, which is wrong.

value: Both Hawaii and Alaska have 30 December 2023

value: Hail formation usually during the monsoon season is the incorrect statement
